title: Skateboarding
text: Skateboarding is a sport with a board and four wheels. People skate in the street, in parks and in special skateparks. Many children and teenagers love skating.
To skate, you put one foot on the board and you push with the other foot. Then you put both feet on the board and you ride. It is easy to start, but it is difficult to be really good.
Skaters like doing tricks. The most famous trick is the ollie: you jump with the board, and the board stays under your feet. It looks like magic!
Skateboarding is also an Olympic sport. In Tokyo in 2021, a girl from Japan won a gold medal. She was only thirteen years old!
Do you like skating? Remember: always wear a helmet and pads. Falling is part of learning, so do not be afraid. Practice every day and have fun!
